create_poll.title: Make poll
create_poll.description: Make a draft poll: its question, how a choice is made, the groups it goes to and its window.

args.description: Who made the poll, supplied by the mount. Never read from the request.

get_poll.title: Read poll
get_poll.description: Read one poll with its settings and state.

add_choice.title: Add choice
add_choice.description: Add a choice to a draft poll, after the ones it has.

args.description: The poll the choice belongs to. The address decides, not the body.

list_choices.title: List choices
list_choices.description: List a poll's choices in order.

args.description: The poll whose choices to list.

answer_poll.title: Answer poll
answer_poll.description: Answer a poll inside its window, from a caller in one of its groups: the votes placed on each choice, keyed by choice id, and under per_group the group the answer is for. Answers with who answered and when; what was chosen is kept apart.

args.description: The poll answered. The address decides, not the body.
Who answered, supplied by the mount. Never read from the request.

count_poll.title: Count poll
count_poll.description: The holders' count, at any time: the votes on each choice, in order, and how many answered. Computed on every call; who chose what is not in it.

publish_result.title: Publish result
publish_result.description: Publish a poll's result to the groups named in group_ids, whose members may then read its count. Publishing again replaces the groups.

args.description: The poll whose result is published. The address decides, not the body.
Who published the result, supplied by the mount. Never read from the request.

read_published_count.title: Read published result
read_published_count.description: A member's read of a published result: the votes on each choice and how many answered, once the result is published to one of the caller's groups. A poll not published to the caller answers as a missing one.

args.description: The poll whose result to read.
